purpose: Run the full hermetic proof and validation pipeline as the authoritative full-confidence command.
failureSemantics: Fails closed on any non-zero subcommand exit; does not substitute mock success for unavailable providers.
title: Baseline command with empty inputs, outputs, environmentScope and sideEffects
description: Baseline valid command artefact whose inputs, outputs, environmentScope and sideEffects arrays are all empty, which the schema permits, exercising the required-but-may-be-empty array boundary.
aiGuidance: Treat empty inputs/outputs/environmentScope/sideEffects as a deliberate declaration of an environment-agnostic, effect-free command, not as missing data to be inferred.
